metadata.description: Management group Id, to assign a role assignment to
Service principal Object Id, needed for Role Assignment
Subscription ID where deployment resources will be created
Firefly webhook URL for event notifications. If empty, derived from fireflySite.
Enforce storage network rules to restrict access to Firefly IPs only
Firefly IP addresses for storage account network rules
Tags to apply to created resources as array from EditableGrid
Just a Guid to append to deployment script name

resources.name: [guid(parameters('managementGroupId'), 'firefly app config reader mg', parameters('servicePrincipalObjectId'), parameters('newguid'))]

resources.comments: Creating a diagnostic setting that targets a storage account also needs listKeys on that account.
resources.name: [guid(parameters('storageAccountName'), parameters('identityName'), 'firefly diagnostics storage keys')]

properties.condition: ((!(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs/read'} AND NOT SubOperationMatches{'Blob.List'})) OR (@Resource[Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs:path] StringLike '*state') OR (@Resource[Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs:path] StringLike '*.tfstateenv:*'))

resources.name: [guid('firefly custom role deployment subscription', subscription().subscriptionId, parameters('servicePrincipalObjectId'), parameters('newguid'))]

properties.networkAcls: [if(parameters('enforceStorageNetworkRules'), createObject('defaultAction', 'Deny', 'ipRules', map(parameters('fireflyEips'), lambda('ip', createObject('value', lambdaVariables('ip'), 'action', 'Allow')))), createObject('defaultAction', 'Allow'))]

resources.name: [concat('firefly-integration-', parameters('newguid'))]
dependsOn: [guid(parameters('managementGroupId'), 'firefly app config reader mg', parameters('servicePrincipalObjectId'), parameters('newguid'))]
